violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
violation_type.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

finding_variants.text: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.
An employee did not have a pre-employment affidavit form.
Training hours for caregivers were not available at time of inspection.  Personnel training hours were not complete and ready for review during follow up inspection.
Six staff training records were reviewed. Some of training certificates for five of the staff members were not available for review at the time of inspection.
Ten out of ten staff were missing the Pre-employment affidavit form 2912.
Four staff were missing trainings in the special topics.
